description: This file is a Python module for generating trend reports related to sales, purchase, and project data. It contains functions for validating filters, constructing SQL queries dynamically based on filters and parameters, and retrieving data for reports. It also defines helper functions for date ranges and column configurations relevant to periods like monthly, quarterly, etc.

methods.name: get_columns(filters, trans)
methods.description: Constructs and returns filter-based conditions including the columns, grouping, and select clauses for report generation.

methods.name: validate_filters(filters)
methods.description: Checks presence and validity of required filters, throws exceptions if invalid.

methods.name: get_data(filters, conditions)
methods.description: Fetches report data based on provided filters and generated conditions using SQL queries.

methods.name: get_mon(dt)
methods.description: Returns the abbreviated month name for a given date.

methods.name: period_wise_columns_query(filters, trans)
methods.description: Builds column list and query fragment for period-based data (monthly, quarterly, etc.).

methods.name: get_period_wise_columns(bet_dates, period, pwc)
methods.description: Populates the list of period-specific column headers based on the period type.

methods.name: get_period_wise_query(bet_dates, trans_date, query_details)
methods.description: Constructs SQL query fragment to sum data within specific date ranges for each period.

methods.name: get_period_date_ranges(period, fiscal_year=None, year_start_date=None)
methods.description: Generates start and end dates for each period segment within a fiscal year based on period type.

methods.name: get_period_month_ranges(period, fiscal_year)
methods.description: Returns list of months covered in each period segment.

methods.name: based_wise_columns_query(based_on, trans)
methods.description: Returns column configurations, select and group by clauses depending on 'based_on' filter.

methods.name: group_wise_column(group_by)
methods.description: Returns the column for grouping in SQL query based on 'group_by' filter.
